response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), a AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS avg_n FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.n * 1.0) AS avg_invoiced_orders, AVG(g.n - a.avg_n) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.n > a.avg_n
